test_title: Most Repeated 2025 Current Affairs PYQ Subject Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which individual, celebrated as India's first Paralympic gold medalist, was honoured with the Arjuna Lifetime Achievement Award in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Murlikant Petkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Murlikant Petkar** was conferred with the prestigious **Arjuna Lifetime Achievement Award** in **January 2025** in recognition of his pioneering contributions to Indian sports.
 
• He holds the distinction of being **India's first Paralympic gold medalist**, a feat he achieved more than five decades ago.
 
• His historic **gold medal** was won at the **1972 Summer Paralympics** held in **Heidelberg, West Germany**.
 
• He competed in the **50m Freestyle swimming** event, where he set a **World Record** at the time with a finish of **37.33 seconds**.
 
• The award presented in **2025** serves to honor his legacy as the person who put India on the **Paralympic** map long before the nation became a regular contender for medals in the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Military Career and Injury:**
 
 
• Before becoming an athlete, Petkar was a soldier in the **Indian Army**, serving in the **Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers (EME)**.
 
• He sustained severe injuries, including **nine bullet wounds**, during the **1965 Indo-Pak War** in the **Sialkot sector**, which led to him becoming paraplegic.
 
 
 
• **Multifaceted Athlete:**
 
 
• Petkar was a versatile sportsman; he initially represented India in **Table Tennis** at the **1968 Tel Aviv Paralympics**.
 
• Apart from swimming, he has also competed internationally in **Javelin Throw**, **Precision Javelin Throw**, and **Shot Put**.
 
 
 
• **National Honors:**
 
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri**, India's fourth-highest civilian award, in **2018** by the **Government of India**.
 
• His life story was the inspiration for the **2024 biographical film** titled **"Chandu Champion"**, directed by **Kabir Khan** and starring **Kartik Aaryan**.
 
 
 
• **Evolution of Awards:**
 
 
• The **Arjuna Award** is usually given for outstanding performance over the previous **four years**, but the **Lifetime Achievement** category recognizes legends whose impact spans decades.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Devendra Jhajharia:** He is another legendary para-athlete who won **two gold medals** in **Javelin Throw** (**2004 Athens** and **2016 Rio**) and served as a major inspiration for the current generation.
 
• **Mariyappan Thangavelu:** He won the **gold medal** in the **Men's High Jump T42** category at the **2016 Rio Paralympics**.
 
• **Deepa Malik:** She was the **first Indian woman** to win a **Paralympic medal**, securing a **silver** in **Shot Put** at the **2016 Rio Games**.
 
• **Significance of 1972:** Petkar's gold in **1972** was India's only individual **Olympic** or **Paralympic** gold until **Abhinav Bindra** won gold in **2008** and **Devendra Jhajharia** won in **2004**.
